notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a basic land card, creating a 2/2 Bear and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Squirrel or the Bear, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
